description: This source file implements a utility for inspecting and dumping contents of disk cache files used in Chromium, including headers, entries, rankings, and stats, with functions for reading headers, dumping stats, and navigating cache entries.

classes.name: CacheDumper
classes.description: A helper class to interact with cache files, load entries, rankings, and dump data.

methods.name: CacheDumper::Init
methods.description: Initializes cache dumper by setting up block files and mapping the index file.

methods.name: CacheDumper::GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the next cache entry and its address, iterating through the index.

methods.name: CacheDumper::LoadEntry
methods.description: Loads a specific cache entry from disk given its address.

methods.name: CacheDumper::LoadRankings
methods.description: Loads rankings data from disk given its address.

methods.name: CacheDumper::HexDump
methods.description: Creates a hex dump of the data at a given cache address.
